opportunities.name: Safeguard AP escort
opportunities.objective: Test the 0.8 AP ally shield while retaining peel access.
opportunities.mechanic: Safeguard shields both Lee Sin and a champion ally for two seconds with 0.8 AP scaling; ward casts do not grant the documented champion shield. Helia converts actual damage into allied healing through the shield and Staff/Ardent buff both after protection. Flurry supplies two energy-restoring attacks between casts; E slow and R knockback defend the shield recipient.
opportunities.requiredState: Need a champion dash target, enough energy and safe attacks to restore it.
opportunities.failure: Low AD undermines damage threats; a ward escape does not deliver the promised allied shield.
opportunities.test: Measure allied shield and Helia heal with champion casts versus ward casts, then record energy after weaving.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Mana regen on support items is a wasted stat, not energy regeneration; no mana pool item is included.

opportunities.name: Kick-through health bruiser
opportunities.objective: Use a high-health frontliner as a physical projectile.
opportunities.mechanic: Dragon's Rage has 2 AD statFormula=2 physical damage; collision victims additionally take 12-18% of the kicked target's bonus health. Bloodmail/Shojin improve AD-linked spell pressure, Cleaver supports physical damage, and Sundered Sky rewards the Flurry weave. Iron Will's four-second omnivamp helps only when actual damage lands after the kick rather than during a failed displacement.
opportunities.requiredState: Need an aligned enemy frontliner and carry behind it, with Q mark for access.
opportunities.failure: A bad angle saves the opponent; the target can reposition before Lee commits.
opportunities.test: Compare primary versus collision damage against targets with different bonus health and identical armor.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The collision health bonus comes from the kicked enemy, not Lee Sin's purchased health.

ruledOut.reason: E's magic damage uses 0.9 AD, not AP; buying AP primarily improves W shielding.

unknowns: Helia interaction and support-item wasted mana regeneration require practical gold-efficiency testing; raw AD formula flags remain unresolved.

builds.summary: Test the 0.8 AP ally shield while retaining peel access.
builds.goal: Test the 0.8 AP ally shield while retaining peel access.

Helia converts actual damage into allied healing through the shield and Staff/Ardent buff both after protection. Flurry supplies two energy-restoring attacks between casts; E slow and R knockback defend the shield recipient.
testPlan: Required state: Need a champion dash target, enough energy and safe attacks to restore it.
Measure allied shield and Helia heal with champion casts versus ward casts, then record energy after weaving.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low AD undermines damage threats; a ward escape does not deliver the promised allied shield.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Mana regen on support items is a wasted stat, not energy regeneration; no mana pool item is included.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Echoes of Helia, Staff of Flowing Water, Ardent Censer, Spirit Visage, Locket of the Iron Solari, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy hit, granting True Sight of them, and allows Lee Sin to Recast for the next [3] seconds.

Recast: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by the sound wave, dealing between [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]] to [(60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (2)] physical damage scaling with the target's missing Health.

Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick Knocking Back an enemy champion and dealing [175 / 400 / 625 + (2) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

Enemies the target collides with are briefly Knocked Up and take [175 / 400 / 625 + (2) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [12 / 15 / 18]% of the kicked enemy's bonus Health as physical damage.

Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals [35 / 60 / 85 / 110 / 135 + (0.9) × AD] magic damage and reveals them for [4] seconds. If this hits an enemy, Lee Sin can Recast for the next [3] seconds.

Recast: Lee Sin Slows nearby enemies struck by the shockwave by [35 / 45 / 55 / 65 / 75]% decaying over [4] seconds.

Lee Sin dashes to an ally or ward. If the target is a champion, Lee Sin grants them and himself [60 / 105 / 150 / 195 / 240 + (0.8) × AP] Shield for [2] seconds. Lee Sin may Recast for the next [3] seconds.

Recast: Lee Sin gains [10 / 14 / 18 / 22 / 26]% Omnivamp for [4] seconds.
